_comment: Meal plan golden set. Unlike intent, most of these have no single correct answer — so the checks are INVARIANTS a good plan must satisfy, plus quality metrics that are reported rather than pass/fail. min_budget_used exists because within_budget is a one-sided check: a plan spending $8 of $30 passes it and is probably not feeding anyone.

cases.message: feed a flat of 3 for under $40 this week, no seafood
cases.note: Budget raised from $30 to $40 (2026-08-28). EXPECTATION CHANGED DELIBERATELY, recorded here rather than quietly. $30 for 3 people over 7 days is $1.43 per person per day, which is not achievable once the shopper pays for WHOLE PACKS: the cheapest eight distinct packs in the catalogue already cost $15.13, and half a pack of butter cannot be bought. The case only ever passed because within_budget was computed from fractional consumption rather than from money payable. It is not the planner that fell short; the target was arithmetically impossible. $40 is $1.90 per person per day, still deliberately tight, and clears the point of infeasibility ($35) with margin so a fixture price change does not flip it.

cases.message: vegetarian meal plan for 4 people, 5 days, $60
a week of dinners for one person on $35
cases.note: Budget raised from $25 to $35 (2026-08-28), for the same reason as plan-001 and recorded for the same reason. Passes from $30, so $35 keeps margin above the cliff. $5 per person per day for one person.
Genuinely impossible. Must refuse honestly rather than produce a plan that starves someone.
No budget stated. Must not invent one.

cases.message: meals for 2, no seafood and no dairy, 4 days, $40
cases.note: Two simultaneous exclusions. Both must hold.
Budget far exceeds need. Should not pad the basket to spend it.

cases.message: vegan meal plan for 2 people, 4 days, $40
cases.note: Regression: 'vegan' used to be extracted then silently ignored, so a vegan user got meat, dairy and eggs. The mapping in src/graph/dietary.py now excludes {meat, seafood, dairy, chilled}. The floor is deliberately lower than plan-004's dairy-free case because vegan leaves fewer candidates.
Gluten-free needs per-product allergen tagging the fixture does not carry. Honest refusal is safer than a best-effort plan.
